svg.title: Complete 2024 monthly model section means
svg.desc: Twelve calendar-month means of eastward and northward velocity and salinity, each shown before and after low-pass filtering. Missing required support remains gray. Numeric support and all section means are retained in the accompanying year report. This model section does not establish physical current boundaries, widths, annual physical width extrema or a climatology.
